description: This file defines a singleton pattern implementation within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including classes for managing singleton instances, singleton templates, and proxy singletons, along with associated methods and internal management structures.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class for singleton pattern, managing registration and disposal of singleton instances.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class implementing singleton pattern for a specific type, providing instance management with thread safety.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing proxy singleton instances, wrapping another type via a proxy.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Pure virtual method to return the implementation name of the singleton.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a singleton instance in the singleton list.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a singleton instance from the singleton list.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes all singleton instances managed by the singleton list.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance, with overloads for thread-safe creation with arguments or default construction.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a singleton instance with provided arguments.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the singleton object, with compile-time differentiation based on default constructibility.
